title: prosopis alba f. fruticosa
intro: Prosopis alba f. fruticosa, commonly known as a variety of the white-green broom or white-green false broom, is a type of shrub or small tree belonging to the family Fabaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing several health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Prosopis alba f. fruticosa include antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties, which help in treating various conditions like wounds, fever, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, contributing to its medicinal value.
